lines.en: The way I walk still isn't right.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖，弯的方向不对。
lines.en: My knees bend the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我一步步，靠近你的房子。
lines.en: Step by step, I near your house.
A lamp burns in the window.

lines.zh: 我不需要睡，也不需要吃。
lines.en: I need neither sleep nor food.

lines.zh: 地面上的影子，跟我不同步。
lines.en: My shadow lags behind me.
I cross the grass without sound.
I'm learning to use this face.
The door isn't locked — good.
I stop outside and listen first.
I practice smiling; it doesn't fit.

lines.zh: 我一步，你的灯就暗一点。
lines.en: Each step, your lamp dims a little.
I avoid the dog; dogs bark.
My breathing is imitated.
I've walked this road many times.
I count the windows of your house.
I stand at the window, motionless.
Pressing my face so long warms the glass.
My eyes have been open a long while.
Someone moves inside.
I don't tire; I only wait.
This door is an inch shorter than me.
Two breaths inside; I count.
I don't knock; I only stand.

lines.zh: 我的手指，比昨天长了一点。
lines.en: My fingers are a little longer than yesterday.
I wait for you to forget the lock.
The curtain stirs.
I smile; my face is stiff.

lines.zh: 天快亮了，我得换个地方。
lines.en: Dawn's near; I should move.
I'm learning to make your face.
Don't look at me when you open the door.
We look very much alike.
Three nights I've stood at your window.
I've learned to say your name.
Don't turn off the light; I'm not done looking.
When you look back, I smile.
I'm not your family.
No need to run; you can't.
I'd like to sit inside.
I can imitate your voice.
I retreat, moving wrongly.
That pain means nothing.
I return to my spot.
The smile doesn't change.
A part of me has caved in.
This body of mine has no blood.
That only brought me closer.
Only fire makes me come apart.
I don't feed through a mouth.
Those are for the living.
Leaving it at the door?
I don't need your food.
It's something else I want.
It'll go cold in the bowl.
That bait is too small.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我连看都不看。
lines.en: Hold it out; I won't even look.
I didn't come to beg.
Keep it; you'll need it.
I don't smell hunger.
I can wait much longer.
Save those for yourself.
You think that'll send me away?
A whole night, and I haven't eaten.
I'll watch while you eat.

lines.zh: 你碰到我了，我却是冷的。
lines.en: You touched me; I'm cold.
My body isn't quite a body.
I step back, moving strangely.
You rushed me; I barely moved.
That touch will stay with you.
My bones sit wrongly.
The smile on my face moved.
A door stands between us.
Don't touch me; you'll have nightmares.
We need no companions.

lines.zh: 同类见面，只是并肩站着。
lines.en: Kin meet and simply stand together.
We don't use words between us.
Sometimes we swap a face.

lines.zh: 两个影子，落在同一面墙上。
lines.en: Two shadows on one wall.
We don't breed; we multiply.

lines.zh: 你看见的，可能是我，也可能是它。
lines.en: What you see may be me, or it.
We have no names.
We have no such thing.
We just stand here.
I pick it up and sniff.
It fell; I pick it up.
I set it back on the sill as it was.
I'll keep your key.

lines.zh: 我捡起它，指尖一点温度也没有。
lines.en: I pick it up, and my fingertips carry no warmth at all.
I turn it twice in my hand.
I push it under the door.

lines.zh: 你留下的东西，我替你收着。
lines.en: What you left behind, I'll keep for you.
The door opens; you've come out.
This is the moment I waited for.
I've taken your face already.
Whatever you do, don't turn.
I'm walking toward you now.
No lamps on this road.
You walk fast; I don't hurry.
I'll stay behind you.
Only a few steps between us.
You won't sleep well tonight.
I'm at your window.
Did you hear the glass?

lines.zh: 我一直站在同一个位置。
lines.en: I've stood in the same spot.
The light's off; I'm still here.
You dare not look twice.
My face is against the door.
Count to a hundred; I won't leave.
I've learned your footsteps.
One way out of this house.
I won't break in; I'll wait.
I reach out and take your shoulder.
My strength isn't quite human.
You can't pull away from this.
No hurry; I have all night.
My fingers dig into the cloth.
Scream; I won't stop.
The smile stays on my face.
Struggle and your joints creak.
This isn't a fight.
We're unnaturally close.
I stand outside your house.

lines.zh: 灯下有个影子，多了一个。
lines.en: One extra shadow under the lamp.
I come out from behind the treeline.
Wind through the door crack.
My face appears at the window first.
Dark now — good.

lines.zh: 我数了数，这户只有一个人。
lines.en: This house holds only one person.
I raise a hand and knock once.
The grass doesn't bend under me.
I know this road.
Fire melts my face.
The blast tears me apart.
Something went into my chest.
That force pushes me away.
Hunger is nothing to do with me.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮我的脸，很难看。
lines.en: The flash shows my face — ugly.
I fall, still smiling.
